issues.issue: Governmental spending is listed by object, so per the by-object rule the category is the function of the fund it is printed under. 97% of this line is General Fund, so it should be general government (with a 'listed by object' review note). The matching detail lines (detail[28] General, detail[40] Street) already use general government / streets/highways, so the report is inconsistent with itself.

issues.on_page: Professional Services 72,670.52 = General 6,837.97 + Street 15,200.00 + Fire 1,083.60 + ARPA 49,548.95 (pp6-7)
issues.issue: The review note says 'General, Street, Fire and ARPA funds', but the largest share (49,548.95, 68%) is the ARPA Fund column, not the General Fund. Under the by-object rule the dominant fund's function would apply, and the ARPA fund's function is not printed. General government is defensible, but it is not the dominant fund's function.

The receipt categories list rural fire contracts under charges for services/fees. The Statement of Activities (p2) shows the amount under Operating Grants and Contributions, so state aid is defensible, but a county fire contract payment could be charges for services.
